name: revised_self_adaptive_ea
summary: This EA detects Bullish and Bearish Engulfing candlestick patterns confirmed by RSI overbought/oversold levels, and draws signal arrows on the chart. It initializes ATR and MA indicators for planned dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop functionality, but the OnTick handler is incomplete and does not execute any trades. The code appears to be a work-in-progress with only the signal detection and visualization components implemented.
summary_zh: 该EA通过检测看涨吞没和看跌吞没K线形态，并结合RSI超买超卖水平进行确认，在图表上绘制信号箭头。它初始化了ATR和MA指标用于计划中的动态止损、止盈和追踪止损功能，但OnTick处理程序不完整，未执行任何实际交易。代码似乎是一个未完成的工作，仅实现了信号检测和可视化组件。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于K线形态识别，主要利用吞没形态（Engulfing Pattern）作为反转信号。入场条件为：看涨吞没形态（前一根阴线被当前阳线吞没）且RSI低于30时发出买入信号；看跌吞没形态（前一根阳线被当前阴线吞没）且RSI高于70时发出卖出信号。出场条件方面，代码声明了动态止损、动态止盈和追踪止损变量，但OnTick函数中未实现任何出场逻辑。仓位管理方面，有固定手数参数（0.05）和最大风险百分比参数（1.0%），但未实际使用风险百分比计算仓位大小。资金管理方面，代码中定义了最大点差过滤参数，但未在信号检测中实际应用。整体策略逻辑不完整，信号检测与交易执行之间存在脱节，ATR和MA指标虽已初始化但未被任何逻辑引用。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on candlestick pattern recognition, primarily utilizing Engulfing Patterns as reversal signals. Entry conditions are: a Bullish Engulfing pattern (previous bearish candle engulfed by current bullish candle) with RSI below 30 generates a buy signal; a Bearish Engulfing pattern (previous bullish candle engulfed by current bearish candle) with RSI above 70 generates a sell signal. For exit conditions, the code declares dynamic stop-loss, dynamic take-profit, and trailing stop variables, but the OnTick function does not implement any exit logic. Position sizing includes a fixed lot parameter (0.05) and a maximum risk percentage parameter (1.0%), but the risk percentage is never actually used to calculate position size. Money management includes a maximum spread filter parameter, but it is not applied in the signal detection logic. The overall strategy logic is incomplete, with a disconnect between signal detection and trade execution, and ATR and MA indicators are initialized but never referenced by any logic.

parameters.name: MaxRiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易最大风险百分比

pros: 使用吞没形态结合RSI确认，策略逻辑有双重过滤，减少假信号
声明了ATR动态止损止盈机制，设计思路合理，适应市场波动
包含最大点差过滤和风险百分比参数，考虑了交易成本和资金管理
使用魔术号码区分EA订单，避免与其他策略冲突
信号可视化（箭头标记）便于回测和策略验证
pros_en: Combining Engulfing patterns with RSI confirmation provides dual filtering to reduce false signals
ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism is a sound design that adapts to market volatility
Includes maximum spread filter and risk percentage parameters, showing consideration for trading costs and money management
Uses a magic number to distinguish EA orders, avoiding conflicts with other strategies
Signal visualization with arrow markers facilitates backtesting and strategy verification
cons: OnTick函数不完整，未实现任何交易执行逻辑，EA实际上无法交易
ATR和MA指标已初始化但从未使用，dynamicStopLoss等变量声明但未赋值
MaxRiskPercent和MaxSpread参数未在任何逻辑中调用，形同虚设
吞没形态判断逻辑有误：使用shift=1和shift=2比较，但注释和实际比较不匹配（不是真正的吞没形态判断）
没有新柱检测机制，每个tick都会重新检测信号，可能产生重复信号
缺少持仓检查和重复下单保护，可能开多个同方向仓位
cons_en: The OnTick function is incomplete with no trade execution logic implemented, making the EA unable to actually trade
ATR and MA indicators are initialized but never used; dynamicStopLoss and other variables are declared but never assigned values
MaxRiskPercent and MaxSpread parameters are never called in any logic, rendering them effectively useless
The engulfing pattern detection logic is flawed: using shift=1 and shift=2 comparisons does not correctly identify a true engulfing pattern
No new bar detection mechanism exists, causing signal re-evaluation on every tick which may produce duplicate signals
Missing position check and duplicate order protection, potentially opening multiple positions in the same direction
improvements: 完善OnTick函数，实现完整的交易执行逻辑，包括入场、止损止盈设置和追踪止损
修正吞没形态判断逻辑，确保当前K线实体完全包含前一根K线实体
添加新柱检测机制，避免每个tick重复检测和绘制箭头
使用MaxRiskPercent动态计算仓位大小，用ATR值设置动态止损止盈
添加持仓检查和点差过滤逻辑，防止重复开仓和高点差环境下交易
improvements_en: Complete the OnTick function with full trade execution logic including entry, stop-loss/take-profit placement, and trailing stop implementation
Fix the engulfing pattern detection logic to ensure the current candle body fully engulfs the previous candle body
Add a new bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant signal checking and arrow drawing on every tick
Implement dynamic position sizing using MaxRiskPercent and set dynamic stop-loss/take-profit using ATR values
Add position check and spread filter logic to prevent duplicate orders and trading in high-spread environments

risk_points: EA交易逻辑未完成，存在变量未初始化使用的风险，可能在后续开发中引入严重bug
没有持仓检查机制，如果补全交易逻辑后不加保护，可能导致无限开仓
没有新柱检测，每个tick都会触发信号检测，可能频繁开仓
吞没形态判断逻辑有缺陷，可能产生错误信号导致亏损交易
risk_points_en: EA trade logic is incomplete, with uninitialized variable usage risk that could introduce severe bugs in future development
No position check mechanism exists; if trade logic is completed without protection, it could lead to unlimited position opening
No new bar detection means signal checking triggers on every tick, potentially causing frequent trade entries
The engulfing pattern detection logic is flawed, potentially generating false signals leading to losing trades
